policy: Positive amplitude m=2..12; m=1 exact source-bank replay. No changed substitution, arbitrary shifts, or bank mixing. Original labels retained, unrated basic substitution classified moderate locally.

exceptions.evidence: Eight sources at basis 1941: two rated moderate, five rated hard, one unrated. No easy bank or worked-solution template. Bounded package implements observed substitution workloads; absence does not prove mathematical impossibility. New source evidence reopens classification.
